page_title: TOU 1-2 MNT | Toulouse v Montpellier 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' The corner from Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is intercepted by the defence.
90+2' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+1' A quickly taken corner by Toulouse.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Miha Zajc (Toulouse) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
89' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) replacing Mousa Tamari.
89' A substitution has been made. Becir Omeragic goes off and Birama Toure (Montpellier) comes on.

88' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Benjamin Lecomte shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
88' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) steps up to send the ball in.
87' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Toulouse win a corner kick.
85' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Jaydee Canvot and he is replaced by Rafik Messali (Toulouse).
85' It is time for a substitution. Frank Magri (Toulouse) is on for Aron Donnum.
83' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header past the goalkeeper into the middle of the goal.
82' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 9:15.

79' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
76' Substitution. Miha Zajc (Toulouse) has come on for Denis Genreau.
76' Denis Genreau (Toulouse) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Benjamin Lecomte scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
76' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
74' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

73' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Clement Turpin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

72' Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
69' Substitution. Joshua King walks off the pitch and Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.
67' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
65' The shots on goal statistics – 4:2.
62' 1 - 1 Goal! Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
61' The substitution has been made. Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) has replaced Rabby Nzingoula.
60' Jean-Louis Gasset prepares a substitution. Wahbi Khazri is replaced by Othmane Maamma (Montpellier).

59' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a magnificent shot into the top left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Benjamin Lecomte, so the score changes to 1:0.
59' What a great touch by Aron Donnum (Toulouse) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked.
57' Montpellier can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
49' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is able to continue to play.
48' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
47' Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
47' Toulouse seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Clement Turpin blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
45+2' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45+1' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' The Montpellier players are stunned as referee Clement Turpin changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
43' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Toulouse, he's going to review using VAR.

42' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Toulouse!
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joris Chotard (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Clement Turpin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Benjamin Lecomte leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Aron Donnum (Toulouse).
38' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) takes the corner.
38' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Toulouse will take a corner kick.
37' Benjamin Lecomte displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
35' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
32' Mousa Tamari (Montpellier) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Clement Turpin who sees an offensive foul.
31' The ball is crossed into the box and Joshua King (Toulouse) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte gets a glove on it to thwart him.

29' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Toulouse are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
26' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
26' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
24' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

23' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Guillaume Restes to get hold of the ball.
20' Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
19' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Clement Turpin had an easy-decision to make.
10' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
7' Jean-Louis Gasset is forced to make a change. Issiaga Sylla is unable to continue due to injury, Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) comes on.
7' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) picks up an injury.
6' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
5' Toulouse are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Clement Turpin will officiate today.
